Why Synthiq

Built for the long run, not just the launch.

  1. 01

    Senior people on the work

    The engineers you meet in the first call are the ones writing your code. No hand-off to a junior bench after the contract is signed.

  2. 02

    Operations in the plan

    Monitoring, runbooks and on-call are scoped from day one, because a system that is hard to run is not finished.

  3. 03

    Plain reporting

    A weekly note covers what shipped, what slipped and why, in language your finance team can read too.
